capabilities: Publish the active note to a new Telegraph page
Update an existing Telegraph page linked via frontmatter
Clear the published content of a page
Create a Telegraph account and store its access token
disambiguation: Not Obsidian's Publish service; it publishes notes to Telegraph (telegra.ph) web pages.
extras: At the time of the README the plugin was still in review for the community plugin store, installed manually from GitHub releases or via BRAT. The README includes a detailed table of which Markdown syntax Telegraph supports, noting limits like flattened nested lists and strike-through/highlight not rendering.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Publish only works with Obsidian's paid service, so users have no built-in way to push a note to a free Telegraph page.
summary: Publishes the active note to a Telegraph (telegra.ph) page and tracks the page URL in frontmatter.
